Messages.Author: jacksonmusic
Messages.Body:
I have some questions...
1- is entombment considered a hand strike?
2- and if so, would song of serenity can be used to prevent damage from that hand strike?

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
1) No.  Entombment is an AWESOME strike. It should be used liberally after  Arms of the Abyss .

2) Entombment doesn't do damage, so wouldn't be affected by  Song of Serenity even if it were a hand strike.

A strike is only a hand-strike when: it is a non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based on the striking minion's strength, or any minion's non-ranged damage-dealing innate strike. { LSJ 19970224 }

(Refer to the  General Rulings link on the left for that definition.)

Messages.Author: jacksonmusic
Messages.Body: ok.. so it is not a hand strike.. can it affect at long range? can it be dodged?

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Entombment is not a ranged strike (neither is  Coma ) so it has no effect on the potential victim if the range is set to Long. Both can be played at Long Range (if you really need to burn the blood on that stolen vampire, for example), but neither has an effect on the target victim.

Entombment can be dodged (as can Coma) like any other strike.

LSJ 01 Feb 2001

LSJ 27 Nov 2000

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> jacksonmusic wrote:
> I have some questions...
> 1- is entombment considered a hand strike?
>
The  General Rulings page gives the definition for what a hand strike is: "any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based on the striking minion's strength, or any minion's non-ranged damage-dealing innate strike."

Name: Entombment
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Obtenebration
[obt] Strike: burn the opposing ally.
[OBT] Strike: send the opposing vampire into torpor.

Entombment is
- not ranged
- not a weapons strike
- doesn't inflict damage based on strength
- isn't innate-dealing-damage.

For these reasons, Entombment isn't a hand strike.

> jacksonmusic wrote:
> 2- and if so, would song of serenity can be used to prevent damage from that hand strike?
>
Name: Song of Serenity
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Animalism
Only usable before range is chosen.
[ani] The opposing minion gets -1 strength this round. A vampire may play only one Song of Serenity each combat.
[ANI] As above, but for the remainder of combat.

Moot - Entombment isn't a hand strike.
